name: Trailblazers: Charlottesville to Shenandoah
org: Shenandoah National Park Trust with Appalachian Conservation Corps and the City of Charlottesville (CAYIP)
what_you_do: Join a summer crew that fixes the Rivanna Trail around Charlottesville. At the end, you do a three day camping and trail job in Shenandoah National Park.
who_can_apply: Charlottesville residents ages 16 to 18. This was the rule for the first group in the news story.
pay_detail: Performance-based stipend of up to $15 per hour, not to exceed $1,800, up to 20 hours a week.
duration: About six to seven weeks (the article gives both numbers)
deadline_text: The article gives no dates. Recruitment ran through the city youth internship (CAYIP) school recruitment each spring.
how_to_apply: Apply when the Charlottesville youth internship program (CAYIP) visits schools. Ask CAYIP or the Shenandoah National Park Trust if it will run again.
notes: Described as a pilot. The page is a news article from a partner group, not a program page, and the year is not stated. Check with CAYIP before counting on it. Related CAYIP card already exists in the guide.
